row.body: The map shows a farm track ending at a thick road-closure bar. The keyring lies beyond it, tied to a tag stamped “county return.” Beside the bar, “all clear” is checked although the road is still crossed out.
row.title: The key past the closure bar

sidecar.gloss: A county access key and a closure record contradict each other.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm worker could mark a temporary gate closure and reclaim a county key after a shift; a crossed-out route does not prove an official evacuation failure.
